Overall, Bluestone delivered a smooth, transparent, and customer-friendly experience. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for beautifully designed jewellery and exceptional service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Revisiting Tanishq after 14 years felt truly special. The last time we visited was before my marriage, and of course a lot has changed since then — people, interiors, designs, and definitely the gold rates!

But what has beautifully remained the same is the warmth, hospitality, empathy, and genuine understanding of customer needs. From the moment we walked in, it never felt like 14 years had passed. That consistency in customer experience reflects the true Tata culture.

A very special mention to Mr. Deepak Trivedi for his immense patience, guidance, and determination to help us through every step without ever making us feel rushed. His professionalism and calm approach made the entire experience even more memorable.

It was not just shopping for jewellery, but an experience filled with trust, comfort, and nostalgia.
Thank you once again to the entire team at Tanishq for making our visit so memorable. ✨

featured_reviews.name: Reshma Chitnis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Always have a great experience at Prakash! We have been customers since the shop opened.
They always have an amazing collection of gold, 1gm gold, silver, and stunning pearl jewelry—both traditional and modern designs. The variety is impressive, so there’s something for every taste and occasion. Prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality and craftsmanship.
What truly sets this place apart is the owners & staff—extremely friendly, patient, and knowledgeable, making the entire shopping experience comfortable and enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for beautiful jewelry at great prices!

featured_reviews.review_text:

Highly recommend them for their quality, professionalism, and heartfelt service.
Thank you so much Prakash Bhau

featured_reviews.name: Dr Rituparna Basumatary
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointing experience at Kalyan Jewellery, Matunga. The pricing is misleading, and the making charges are extremely high with poor transparency. I was in a hurry at the time of purchase and only later realised that I was charged 26% making charges for a very simple ring, which is unreasonable. Customers should be very careful and clarify all charges beforehand, as the final price can be much higher than expected.

featured_reviews.name: Preeti Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly delightful experience at Kalyan Jewellers. From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted with warmth and hospitality. Ms. Pooja was exceptionally kind and attentive, guiding me expertly as I explored the stunning array of jewellery. However, it was Mr. Anand, the Manager, who truly stood out. He was not only a wonderful person with an infectious smile but also incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain each piece in detail, making it easy for someone without much experience to understand the intricacies of the jewellery. His patience and enthusiasm were evident, and I felt well-supported in my selections. The entire staff was equally impressive—each member displayed impeccable manners and genuine helpfulness. Overall, my visit to Kalyan Jewellers was a remarkable experience, and I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to everyone there for their exceptional service.
.
